item.title: Is the Canon R3 Mk II Possible in 2026?
item.description: When the Canon EOS R3 was launched, it floored us with its powerhouse performance. Now that the R1 has been introduced (and also had its fair share of feedback), the question looms: Will Canon create a successor to the Canon R3?

item.title: Is Fujifilm Working on Another Medium Format Compact Camera?
item.description: Fujifilm cameras and lenses have consistently gained popularity among users of APS-C and medium format sensors. It now appears that the company is working on new prime lenses, which are not exactly fast, but this leads one to question the company's future. Here is a look at what the new patent discloses.

item.title: Aiarty Image Matting: The Photo Background Remover That Nails Intricate Pictures
item.description: Background removal used to be a niche task reserved for commercial retouchers. Today, it’s rapidly becoming part of every photographer’s workflow, from portrait shooters delivering clean composites to product photographers producing consistent catalog images. Whether you’re working on client campaigns, wedding galleries, social content, or high-end composites, having a reliable photo background remover has become as essential as having a good RAW processor.

item.title: Is Canon Developing a New 300mm Lens?
item.description: Over the years, Canon has released multiple patents that showcase its research on various lenses. For instance, we have patents for 300-800mm f8L IS USM, 200-400mm f4 IS USM, or the 500mm f4 IS. Although none of the lenses have become a reality, this highlights the importance of telephoto lenses for Canon users. Adding to this list is the new patent for three prime telephoto lenses, which feature a fast aperture. Here is a glimpse into the patents.
